title: Crystalline Realizations of 1-Motives: Integral Structure and Classification via Linear Frobenius
summary: We study morphisms and integral weight splittings in the contravariant Dieudonné realization of Deligne $1$-motives over a finite field. Combining the classical Tate theorem with a finite-level divisibility criterion, we prove integral full faithfulness after $p$-adic completion of morphism groups. We identify the geometric extension classes killed by the Barsotti--Tate realization and determine the exact common $p$-power denominator of the weight projectors from the extension maps of a $1$-motive and its Cartier dual.
